environment: Chrome with locally rebuilt Vue bundle, local Go API and disposable PostgreSQL schema; first fixture had six synthetic TEXT and two DM messages, second fixture had 66 TEXT messages plus two browser sends; no production data or media

checks.name: regression_before_fix
checks.detail: At 1440x900 the candidate showed the newest TEXT message first and the beginning-of-history marker after the oldest row, unlike the reference's chronological reading order. Both new SSR regression tests failed before implementation.

checks.name: chronological_text_and_dm
checks.detail: After rebuilding, the browser accessibility tree and 1440x900 screenshot showed TEXT messages oldest to newest with the history marker above them. Two synthetic DM sends appeared oldest to newest. Server/API stores retain their descending order and cursor semantics.

checks.name: narrow_viewport_and_scroll
checks.detail: At 640x700 CSS px the browser document scrollWidth was 640. The TEXT list showed newest messages near the composer with scrollTop about 231 of 680 scrollHeight and 449 clientHeight; its DOM first/last messages remained oldest/newest.

checks.name: paginated_anchor_and_new_message_follow
checks.detail: With 66 seeded TEXT messages at 640x700 CSS px, initial scroll was at the bottom of a 50-message page. Clicking the top previous-messages control loaded all 66 and kept the previously visible row at the same 140 CSS px top coordinate. A new browser send while at the bottom followed to the new maximum scroll; a second send while scrolled up preserved scrollTop and the visible row coordinate. Document scrollWidth remained 640.

checks.name: native_validation
checks.detail: Focused SSR tests were red before implementation and green after; complete frontend suite passed 166 files/482 tests, and vue-tsc plus Vite build passed.

checks.name: fixture_cleanup
checks.detail: Browser viewport override reset and tab closed; disposable schema count zero, ports 18085/18771 idle, temporary attachment directory and Go binaries removed.

remaining: DES-08 remains open: screenshots were visually inspected but not stored as comparable artifacts; reference demo chrome/content differ from the product fixture, and selected stream/connected voice, 125/150% zoom and full pixel comparison were not run. QA-05 still needs trusted candidate acceptance.
